title: GraphMorph: Tubular Structure Extraction by Morphing Predicted Graphs
mechanism: Graph decoder predicts branch-level graph per patch; SkeletonDijkstra morphs it onto the centreline probability map; graph used to remove false positives.
adaptation: Use only as a crack false-positive filter (drop components not on predicted branches) and as crack topology for severity.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + graph decoder FP filter; baseline = PF; 3 seeds; relP@2 at fixed relR@2. Kill if relP@2 gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: centreline and segmentation tasks on several vessel and road datasets; fewer false positives.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use only as a crack false-positive filter on PF output (drop components not on a predicted branch), aimed at scuff/decoy false alarms on E1; graph gives crack topology for severity.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm PF + GraphMorph filter vs PF; metric crack relP@2 at fixed relR@2 on CV and E1; kill if relP@2 +<0.01.
